# Pasak (Bulwark) — Dokumentasi Resmi

> WAF mandiri (self-hosted), mesin deteksi ancaman, dan pustaka audit keamanan
> headless untuk Laravel (PHP ^8.2–^8.5, Laravel ^10–^13). 100% Pure PHP, tanpa NPM.
> Paket: robyajo/pasak (MIT). Bahasa: Indonesia.

- Situs: https://security-dev.pekanbaru.go.id/
- GitHub: https://github.com/robyajo/pasak
- Packagist: https://packagist.org/packages/robyajo/pasak
- Instalasi: `composer require robyajo/pasak` lalu `php artisan pasak:install`
